title: Empirical Evaluation of Policy-Gradient Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Service Control in an M/M/1 Queue
abstract: This work evaluates policy-gradient reinforcement learning methods for service-rate control in a stochastic queueing system, with attention to policy structure, training stability, and simulation-based validation.

title: State-Action Space Growth in Discrete Machine-Interference Repair Control with Speed-Dependent Failures
abstract: A study of state and action growth, exact dynamic programming boundaries, and scalable solution approaches for controlled finite-source machine repair systems.

title: Simulation-Based Evaluation of Reinforcement Learning Policies for Dynamic Queue Control
abstract: A visual summary of reinforcement learning experiments for adaptive queueing control under uncertain arrivals and operating costs.
